content: alexcrichton requested dicej for a review on PR #14923.

alexcrichton opened PR #14923 from alexcrichton:fix-bail-bug-4 to bytecodealliance:main:

This commit fixes a possible bail_bug! being hit when a guest task is cancelled before it's started. In this situation the pending "switch item" was getting mixed up due to the assumptions of the internal cleanup_thread function.
